text: 据美联社，美国总统特朗普旗下Truth Social于当地时间8月1日推出名为“Truth API”的高速信息服务，向华尔街交易机构收费提供特朗普社交媒体帖文的快速访问渠道，引发有关内幕交易、利益冲突以及利用公职谋取私人利益的质疑。 消息称，<u>Truth API收费高达每月10万美元，目标客户主要是高频交易公司。由于特朗普经常通过Truth Social发布涉及关税、战争、央行领导层及其他重大政策的消息，这些内容往往会迅速引发股票、债券、汇率和大宗商品价格波动</u>。批评者认为，即使帖子理论上同时向公众发布，付费客户通过更快的数据接口和自动交易系统
text_en: According to AP, President Trump's Truth Social on Aug. 1 launched a high-speed information service called 'Truth API,' charging Wall Street trading firms for fast access to Trump's social media posts, raising questions about insider trading, conflicts of interest, and using public office for private gain. Reports say Truth API costs up to $100,000 per month, targeting mainly high-frequency trading firms. Since Trump often uses Truth Social to post about tariffs, wars, central bank leadership, and other major policies, these posts quickly move stocks, bonds, currencies, and commodities. Critics argue that even if posts are theoretically released to the public simultaneously, paying clients can act via faster data feeds and automated trading systems.
